TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

    name "5K run endurance"
  GOAL secondary strength:
    name "General strength and resiliency"
  GOAL tertiary strength:
    name "Race pace speed"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Introduction" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Brisk walk + run intervals":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk 1x5..10 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          run 6x1..1 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Interval walk-run + strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          walk 1x5..8 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          run 4x1..2 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 4m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Sustained brisk walk + strength B":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          walk 1x20..22 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 4m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 33m "Increase run intervals":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk 1x4..6 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          run 5x2..2 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 38m "Steady intervals + strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          walk 1x4..6 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          run 3x3..3 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          front_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 4m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Long brisk walk with short runs + strength B":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          walk 1x15..18 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          run 3x1..1 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 4m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 36m "Build continuous running segments":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 3x4..4 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          walk 1x6..8 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Intervals and breathing focus + strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 4x3..4 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          diaphragmatic_breathing 1x5..5 rpe 3 rest 0 seconds
          squat 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x40..60 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 4m
      DAY Friday training 38m "Longer walk-run + strength B":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          walk 1x10..12 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          run 2x5..5 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 38m "Sustained runs":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 2x8..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          walk 1x6..6 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 42m "Progression run + strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x12..12 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
          walk 1x8..8 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          deadlift 3x5..6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 4m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Endurance walk with short run + mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          walk 1x20..22 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          run 1x5..5 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 1x2..2 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          calf_stretch 1x2..2 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m

    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Continuous running introduction":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x15..18 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
          walk 1x5..5 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Tempo run + strength C":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x10..12 rpe 7 rest 0 seconds
          run 4x1..1 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          front_squat 3x5..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          side_plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 4m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Long walk-run steady + strength B":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk 1x15..18 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          run 2x6..6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds

          calf_raise 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 46m "Long continuous run":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x20..20 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
          walk 1x5..5 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 46m "Tempo intervals + strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 2x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          run 6x2..2 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          deadlift 3x4..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 4m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Endurance walk + run":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk 1x12..15 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          run 2x8..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 7m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Extended run with pace surges":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x25..25 rpe 7 rest 0 seconds
          run 4x1..1 rpe 8 rest 30 seconds
          run 6x30..30 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
          walk 1x5..5 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 48m "Tempo run + intervals + strength C":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x15..18 rpe 7 rest 0 seconds
          run 4x2..2 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          diaphragmatic_breathing 1x5..5 rpe 3 rest 0 seconds
          front_squat 3x4..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Long steady run + strength B":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk 1x10..12 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          run 1x15..18 rpe 7 rest 0 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 7m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Saturday training 60m "Parkrun test (5K)":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x5..5 rpe 8 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
      DAY Monday training 52m "Continuous run progress with pace efforts":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x28..28 rpe 7 rest 0 seconds
          run 6x30..60 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          walk 1x4..4 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 48m "Speed endurance + tempo efforts + strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x12..15 rpe 7 rest 0 seconds
          run 6x4..4 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          run 10x200..200 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
          squat 3x5..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Long run (goal distance focus) + mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x30..30 rpe 7 rest 0 seconds
          run 10x20..20 rpe 8 rest 40 seconds
          walk 1x8..8 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 1x2..2 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          calf_stretch 1x2..2 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 7m

          walking 10m

          walking 6m

        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:

          run 5x1..1 rpe 9 rest 30 seconds
          run 4x200..200 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds

        cooldown:
          walking 7m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progress to continuous 5K at goal pace":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x35..40 rpe 7 rest 0 seconds
          run 4x3..4 rpe 8..9 rest 60 seconds
          run 6x200..200 rpe 9 rest 45 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 48m "Sharpening intervals + tempo + light strength":

          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x12..15 rpe 7 rest 0 seconds

        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Friday training 65m "Long steady run with pace finishing":

          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x40..40 rpe 7 rest 0 seconds
          run 6x1..1 rpe 9 rest 45 seconds
          run 6x400..400 rpe 8..9 rest 90 seconds
          walk 1x10..10 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 7m

      DAY Monday training 45m "Taper run with race-pace efforts":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x30..32 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
          run 4x2..2 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
          run 4x100..100 rpe 9 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Short intervals + light strength":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          run 6x400..400 rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          run 6x200..200 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 2x30..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Easy shakeout":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          walk 1x10..12 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          run 1x8..8 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 4m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Race-week finisher - light prep":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x10..12 rpe 7 rest 0 seconds
          run 4x30..30 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x30..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Race-week sharpen - short efforts":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          run 4x200..200 rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          run 4x100..100 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Friday training 25m "Pre-race activation":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          run 4x60..60 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          diaphragmatic_breathing 1x3..3 rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 4m
      DAY Saturday training 35m "5K Race Day - goal effort":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x30..35 rpe 9 rest 0 seconds
          run 4x100..100 rpe 9 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m

NOTE "Asthma guidance":
  content "Warm up thoroughly before runs, tempo sessions, parkrun and interval work; extend warm-up when cold and avoid maximal efforts in very cold conditions. Treat Parkrun as a test and race-week sessions as controlled sharpening; prioritise breathing control and gradual progression. Carry SABA inhaler as prescribed; stop and use inhaler if significant wheeze or breathlessness; seek medical help if symptoms do not improve."
